target: At least 10 percent full-command improvement on one wide preparation target
protected_review: Investigate every paired slowdown exceeding both 5 percent and 0.010 seconds; repeat with fresh paired seeds before deciding
science: Exact samples, statuses, b/V, fit/DoF/certificate and solver decisions except timings for arithmetic-preserving ownership changes; independent explicit-dummy and frequency-replication oracles
primary: Six OLS preparation branches, three seeds, rotated order, untimed small warm-up; 983040 or 245760 rows, 50 controls, selected 4/16 threads
controls: 12 stratified controls: complete IID, weak/dense/bottleneck/cycle/disconnected/unbalanced, small/narrow, no FE, low memory, saved outputs, restricted sample
traces: Five representative separate traced pairs; trace medians are diagnostic, not paired speed claims
memory: Existing modeled/native allocator peaks, process tree RSS sampled at 10ms; native capacity proof must retain candidate-axis bound
scope: Local macOS development only; no SCC, Windows or qualification
